result.instructions: Tools for Kobiyi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers owe us money, and which invoices are overdue?"; "Show the risk status of contact ABC Ltd. against its credit limit."; "Record a 2500.25 TRY bank transfer collection against receivable rc_123 dated today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kobiyi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kobiyi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kobiyi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kobiyi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kobiyi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (cari) with optional search by name, tax number, your ERP externalId, or changes since a time. Kobiyi API: GET /contacts.

external_id.description: Your ERP record key for the contact.

updated_since.description: Only contacts changed after this ISO 8601 time.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its record counts and credit risk (limit, used, available, overdue, level: none, ok, warn, over). Kobiyi API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact (cari) in Kobiyi. Only name is required. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /contacts.

email.description: Must be a valid email address when set.

risk_limit.description: Credit limit in TRY, e.g. "250000.00". null = no limit.

external_id.description: Your ERP record key. Posting it again returns the existing contact.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_receivables
tools.title: List receivables
tools.description: List receivables (invoices owed to you) with status, contact, currency, due-date and invoice-date filters. Kobiyi API: GET /receivables.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_receivable
tools.title: Get a receivable
tools.description: Get one receivable by id, with its status and amounts. Kobiyi API: GET /receivables/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_receivable
tools.title: Create a receivable
tools.description: Create a receivable (an invoice owed to you) for a contact. contact_id and amount are required. With external_id, posting again returns the existing record. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /receivables.

contact_id.description: The contact that owes the amount.

invoice_no.description: Invoice number. Must be unique per receivable.

installments.description: Installment plan. The total must equal amount within 0.01.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_payables
tools.title: List payables
tools.description: List payables (amounts you owe) with status, contact, currency, date and external-id filters. Kobiyi API: GET /payments.

status.description: Payable status filter, as Kobiyi returns it.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: kobiyi_get_payable
tools.title: Get a payable
tools.description: Get one payable by id. Kobiyi API: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: kobiyi_create_payable
tools.title: Create a payable
tools.description: Create a payable (an amount you owe) for a contact. contact_id, amount and date (the due date) are required. This writes a real record. Kobiyi API: POST /payments.

payment_no.description: Document number. Must be unique per contact.

invoice_date.description: Invoice date of the supplier document.

installments.description: Installment plan. The total must equal amount within 0.01.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List collections (money received against receivables), filterable by receivable, date range and external id. Kobiyi API: GET /collections.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: kobiyi_record_collection
tools.title: Record a collection
tools.description: Record money received against a receivable. The receivable status updates; excess money becomes a contact advance. Pass a new idempotency_key per payment. Kobiyi API: POST /collections (Idempotency-Key header).

amount.description: Amount that settles the receivable, in its own currency.

cash_account_id.description: Cash or bank account (from kobiyi_list_cash_accounts) to post the money to.

cash_amount.description: Required when the cash account has another currency: the amount that moved in the account's currency.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this one payment. Send the same key again only to retry the same payment.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_payment_transactions
tools.title: List payment transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (money paid against payables), filterable by payable and date range. Kobiyi API: GET /payment-transactions.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: kobiyi_record_payment_transaction
tools.title: Record a payment
tools.description: Record money you paid against a payable. The payable status updates; excess money becomes a supplier advance. Pass a new idempotency_key per payment. Kobiyi API: POST /payment-transactions (Idempotency-Key header).

cash_account_id.description: Cash or bank account (from kobiyi_list_cash_accounts) the money left.

cash_amount.description: Required when the cash account has another currency: the amount that moved in the account's currency.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this one payment. Send the same key again only to retry the same payment.

tools.name: kobiyi_list_cari_advances
tools.title: List contact advances
tools.description: List contact advances (customer or supplier prepayments) with the amount still unused. Zero balances are hidden unless include_zero is true. Kobiyi API: GET /cari-advances.

include_zero.description: true = include advances with no remaining amount.
